get.description:
Get items from a task run for a specific dataset.

Args:
----
    task_id: ID of the task to get items from
    dataset_id: ID of the dataset to get items from
    eval: Whether to get evaluation set items
    offset: Number of items to skip for pagination
    max_items: Maximum number of items to return
    filters: List of filters to apply to the query
    order_bys: List of order by clauses to apply
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing the items and metadata

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task/dataset not found or unauthorized

Get items from a task's seedset with filtering and pagination.

Args:
----
    task_id: ID of the task to get seedset items from
    offset: Number of items to skip for pagination
    max_items: Maximum number of items to return
    filters: List of filters to apply to the results
    order_bys: List of fields to order results by
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing the filtered and paginated seedset items

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task not found or unauthorized

Get items from a task's evaluation set.

Args:
----
    task_id: ID of the task to get evaluation items from
    model_id: Optional model ID to filter results
    offset: Number of items to skip for pagination
    max_items: Maximum number of items to return
    filters: List of filters to apply to results
    order_bys: List of fields to order results by
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing evaluation set items with:
        - schema: Dataset schema
        - items: List of evaluation items
        - total_count: Total number of items
        - task/dataset metadata

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task not found or unauthorized

post.description:

    filters: List of filters to apply when sampling
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing success status

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task/dataset not found or unauthorized

get.summary: Get Evalset Metrics For Task Run

get.description:
Get all task runs for a specific task.

Args:
----
    task_id: ID of the task to get runs for
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing list of task runs with:
        - id: str - Task run ID
        - project_id: str - Project ID
        - task_id: str - Task ID
        - task_name: str - Task name
        - model_name: str - Model name
        - dataset_id: str - Dataset ID
        - dataset_name: str - Dataset name
        - status: str - Run status
        - is_eval_run: bool - Whether this is an evaluation run
        - created_at: datetime - Creation timestamp
        - updated_at: datetime - Last update timestamp

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task not found or unauthorized

post.description:
Update or manage a task run for a specific task.

Args:
----

    num_items: Number of items to process in run

    eval: Whether this is an evaluation run
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    Response indicating success/failure

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If task not found or unauthorized

post.description:
Modify properties of a labeled item in a dataset.

This endpoint allows modifying properties of items that have already been labeled.
It can add items to the evalset table and set their expected labels based on
the final merged label from LLM and human annotations.

Args:
----
    task_id: ID of the task containing the item
    dataset_id: ID of the dataset containing the item
    item_id: ID of the item to modify
    item_properties: Properties to modify for the item
    model_id: Optional model ID to use
    token: Access token for authentication

Returns:
-------
    ResponseModel containing success/failure status

Raises:
------
    HTTPException: If dataset/task not found or unauthorized
